metadata.description: Massmarket's own Claude Code plugins for the team. Anyone on the pms or web-builders team can release; main keeps its full history.

plugins.name: mm-hooks
plugins.description: Keeps the Massmarket worklog hook and the time tracker extension on this computer current, with nothing for the person to do.

plugins.name: mm-bridge
plugins.description: Pins and names each client thread with what is due, shows the reply drafts in a side pane, never starts a model turn on its own.
